named-native-query.name: EsqOrgJpa.customOrg
named-native-query.query: SELECT opr_par_name as "name" , opr_value as "value" , opr_change_no as "changeNo" FROM esq_org_par WHERE opr_org_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.customUsr
named-native-query.query: SELECT upr_par_name as "name" , upr_value as "value" , upr_change_no as "changeNo" FROM esq_usr_par WHERE upr_usr_pk = :id

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.updateCustomUsr
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_usr_par SET upr_value = :value ,upr_change_no = :changeNo ,upr_crl_id = :correlationId ,upr_req_id = :requestId ,upr_uid = :uid WHERE upr_usr_pk = :id AND upr_par_name = :name

named-native-query.name: EsqUsrJpa.insertCustomUsr
